basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical) Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years (till the last date of the advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Science (including integrated PG degrees) with five years' post-qualification experience in the health related field/research, or PhD with two years' post-qualification experience in the health related field/research
qualification.details: Other conditions: | All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post | Desirable: | Experience in community-based projects, leadership, budget handling, data management Proficiency in Hindi/English/local language

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 78,000 per month + HRA as admissible

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format given with the notice.
Submit the filled application and Bio-data on the day of the walk-in interview.
Appear in person on 21-11-2026 with all relevant original documents.
Bring one set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience.
Enclose all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview Post may increase/decrease as per requirement at the sole discretion of the Principal Investigator No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date Application without essential qualification and experience certificates will be considered incomplete

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post Desirable: Experience in community-based projects, leadership, budget handling, data management Proficiency in Hindi/English/local language

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM on 21-11-2026 will not be entertained Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidates. Initial appointment for two months; may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate Purely temporary basis, co-terminus with the project No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project Purely temporary/contractual basis for the specified period of time and based on the project

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Jodhpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Screening/Scrutiny Test may be conducted depending on the number of applicants Walk-in interview on 21-11-2026 The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application in the prescribed format Bio-data All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience Essential qualification and experience certificates enclosed with the application form No Objection Certificate for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given with the notice. Submit the filled application and Bio-data on the day of the walk-in interview. Appear in person on 21-11-2026 with all relevant original documents. Bring one set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience. Enclose all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview Post may increase/decrease as per requirement at the sole discretion of the Principal Investigator No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date Application without essential qualification and experience certificates will be considered incomplete

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-III (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 21 November 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (till the last date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Service in other research projects Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis (Only Applicable for ICMR Project).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 78,000 per month + HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate Degree in Science (including integrated PG degrees) with five years' post-qualification experience in the health related field/research, or PhD with two years' post-qualification experience in the health related field/research.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications required for the post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM on 21-11-2026 will not be entertained. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview. Screening/Scrutiny Test may be conducted depending on the number of applicants. Walk-in interview on 21-11-2026. The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial appointment for two months; may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate. Purely temporary basis, co-terminus with the project. No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project.
